content.short: ADADAO is a Cardano DeFi protocol for creating fully collateralized stablecoins backed by native Cardano assets.
content.description: ADADAO describes itself as an interest-free stablecoin protocol built on Cardano. The platform is designed to let users create fully collateralized stablecoins using native Cardano assets as backing, with AUSD serving as the protocol's soft-pegged stablecoin. The project presents the system as a trustless smart-contract-based protocol, with on-chain collateral backing each AUSD in circulation. ADAO acts as the ecosystem's utility and governance token, giving holders a role in protocol decisions and a share in the value generated by the platform.
